brief: A counted-thread panel inspired by the phulam gamosa: red on white, all marks on a 4 px cell grid, a 12-cell-wide motif band at the bottom mirrored onto the opposite edge to satisfy the host symmetry, with a mirror-symmetric row of stepped diamonds and crosses, two plain red stripes 2 cells wide along both long edges.
